summary.text: Beau Beaullieu is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 48, representing Iberia, Lafayette, and St. Martin, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Beau Beaullieu with committee assignments including House and Governmental Affairs (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Beau Beaullieu's occupation as Financial Advisor.
It lists Beau Beaullieu's education as Finance Degree, Louisiana State University; MBA, University of Lafayette; Certified 401(K) Professional; Accredited Investment Fiduciary.

The House member page lists Beau Beaullieu's committee assignments as House and Governmental Affairs (Chair); Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay; Legislative Budgetary Control Council.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation (Chair); Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
